decision_units.goal: 完成 Chapter 12.5：新增受限 aiflow observe CLI/CI adapter，复用同一 observation parser、deterministic decision 与 task binding core，证明受支持的 pre-commit/pre-command Hook、CLI apply/dry-run 和 detached CI dry-run 对相同事实给出相同非授权结论；CI 与 dry-run 不写 task ledger，并如实记录 shell/平台覆盖边界。
planned_actions: Refactor the existing current-facts binding check into one public read-only observation evaluation seam without changing the deterministic decision table
Add a bounded observation adapter with explicit apply, dry-run and CI modes, strict mode/source/actor validation and canonical JSON output
Keep apply task-local and idempotent through the existing service while making dry-run and CI strictly non-persistent
Prove semantic parity for every observation kind, route and verification level, plus end-to-end parity for the two actually supported Hook facts
Cover malformed input, ambiguity, stale bindings, path escape, unknown fields, ledger-write prevention and stable exit behavior
Record the supported shell, Hook-install and operating-system boundaries without claiming a generic sandbox
Project only Chapter 12.5 after implementation, formal verification and required review facts are current
